verdict.rationale: Morph's own official MCP server exposes its file-editing and code-search tools to AI clients such as Claude Code. A user can therefore drive Morph's core capabilities through natural-language requests to an agent, but only via a third-party host agent. Morph has no native natural-language interface of its own, and the MCP tools cover edits and search rather than operating the wider product. missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface, natural-language control of account, endpoint, credit and Reflex management, documentation of NL-driven workflows beyond edit/search tools, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
